definition: Court findings are reviewed separately from financial transactions. A program match establishes related litigation, not that every award or recipient is covered. No search match and no review are distinct; neither proves lawful termination. Financial amounts are never replaced by legal annotations.

cases.title: Climate United Fund v. Citibank
cases.court: U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit
cases.label: Termination notice blocked; litigation ongoing
cases.summary: The appeals court upheld preliminary protection against EPA’s March 2025 termination notice. The dispute remains unresolved.
cases.access_status: Access to funds remains separately disputed; the ruling does not establish that recipients can draw money.
cases.coverage_note: The program label marks related litigation. Named-party links use the program and recipient identifiers listed in the filed petition; they do not verify effects on every transaction, subrecipient or project.

timeline.text: Appeals court affirmed the preliminary injunction; the portion blocking the March termination notice had a majority, while the remaining relief was affirmed by an equally divided court.
Court clarified the disbursement stay for Coalition for Green Capital’s previously withdrawn funds; this clarification should not be generalized to every recipient.
EPA filed a petition asking the Supreme Court to review the decision.
Response deadline shown on the Supreme Court docket; no outcome inferred.
